KRONOS.Clock.Halted.no-active-gm: Time is stopped: no GM is connected
KRONOS.Clock.Halted.game-paused: Time is stopped: the game is paused
KRONOS.Clock.Halted.combat: Time is stopped: an encounter is under way
KRONOS.Override.Title: Today's weather
KRONOS.Override.Hint: Applies to this day only. Later days go back to generated weather.
KRONOS.Settings.Latitude.Name: Latitude
KRONOS.Settings.Latitude.Hint: Drives how far sunrise and sunset shift across the year. 48 is central Europe; 0 gives a constant twelve-hour day.
KRONOS.Settings.StepMultiplier.Name: Long step size
KRONOS.Settings.StepMultiplier.Hint: How many units the outer double arrows move by. The inner arrows always move one.
KRONOS.Settings.WeatherEnabled.Name: Show weather
KRONOS.Settings.WeatherEnabled.Hint: Adds the condition and temperature to the bar.
KRONOS.Settings.ClockRatio.Name: Time ratio
KRONOS.Settings.ClockRatio.Hint: Game seconds per real second while the clock runs. 1 is real time; 60 makes an hour pass each minute.
KRONOS.Settings.ClockTick.Name: Tick interval
KRONOS.Settings.ClockTick.Hint: Real seconds between clock updates. Each update is sent to every connected client, so short intervals cost more than they look.
KRONOS.Settings.PauseOnCombat.Name: Stop time during encounters
KRONOS.Settings.PauseOnCombat.Hint: Encounters track their own time in rounds, so the running clock usually should not also advance.
KRONOS.Settings.SceneWeatherSync.Name: Apply weather to scenes
KRONOS.Settings.SceneWeatherSync.Hint: Sets the scene's weather effect to match the day. Never overwrites weather set by hand, and skips scenes opted out in their configuration.
KRONOS.Settings.Calendar.Name: Calendar
KRONOS.Settings.Calendar.Hint: Which calendar the bar reckons in. Golarion keeps Gregorian month lengths and stays in step with the PF2e World Clock; Tarlan has months of its own and will show a different date from it. Requires a reload.
KRONOS.Settings.CalendarFile.Name: Calendar file
KRONOS.Settings.CalendarFile.Hint: Path to a JSON file describing a calendar of your own. Overrides the choice above when set. Leave empty to use it. Requires a reload.
KRONOS.Mapping.Name: Weather effects
KRONOS.Mapping.Label: Configure effects
KRONOS.Mapping.Title: Weather effect for each condition
KRONOS.Mapping.Hint: Which scene ambience each condition applies. The list is whatever this world has registered, so effects added by other modules appear here too.
KRONOS.Scene.OptOut.Name: Ignore calendar weather
KRONOS.Scene.OptOut.Hint: Keeps the calendar from setting this scene's weather. Use for interiors and anywhere underground.
KRONOS.Override.NotApplied: Weather saved, but the scene effect did not change: {reason}.
KRONOS.Settings.DarknessNight.Name: Night darkness
KRONOS.Settings.DarknessNight.Hint: How dark a controlled scene gets at night. 1 is fully dark.
KRONOS.Settings.DarknessDay.Name: Day darkness
KRONOS.Settings.DarknessDay.Hint: How dark a controlled scene stays at midday. 0 is full daylight; raise it for a permanently gloomy world.
KRONOS.Settings.Twilight.Name: Twilight length
KRONOS.Settings.Twilight.Hint: Minutes the light takes to change, centred on sunrise and sunset. Longer is gentler.
KRONOS.Scene.Darkness.Name: Darkness follows the clock
KRONOS.Scene.Darkness.Hint: Sets this scene's darkness level from the time of day, using the seasonal sunrise and sunset. Leave off for interiors and anywhere underground.
KRONOS.Conflict.Pf2eSyncDarkness: the Pathfinder 2e World Clock's own darkness sync
KRONOS.Conflict.Warning: Kronos is controlling this scene's darkness, but so is {others}. Turn one of them off — otherwise they will overwrite each other.
